title: Cognitive Exercise Session Consistency
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=eldercare:activity activity_type=cognitive_exercise
| bin _time span=1w
| stats count as sessions, avg(duration_min) as avg_duration by _time resident
| sort 0 _time resident
description: Trends the frequency and duration of cognitive exercise sessions such as puzzles, memory games, or guided activities.
value: Routine stimulation is easier to sustain when you can see whether it is actually happening week to week.
implementation: Label cognitive exercise sessions in `eldercare:activity` and trend weekly counts and average duration.
visualization: Line chart of weekly cognitive exercise sessions.
grandmaExplanation: It ranks how steadily mentally stimulating activities are happening over time.
